title: Experience Model v6: ratification-candidate common-prefix writer pilot
summary: Retain the complete v7 common-prefix 7B CompilerGym pilot and make five closure repairs only: narrowly authorize the two no-model environment sealers while target inference remains forbidden; terminate the whole manifest on every pre-panel failure; restrict interpretation to literal exact-run values; define postrun update audit as discrete provenance and realized-artifact verification rather than floating-point replay; and require independently authored T01/T02 goldens. No arm, model capability, training row, target, metric, or science claim changes.
system_thesis: One adapter-free four-task lived prefix is cloned into HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL. E alone receives a rank-16 q/v LoRA trained on verified immediate-improvement packet-to-action examples, then both lives continue four tasks and four fixed syntactic targets compare H, E_ON, and same-state E_OFF. This is only a controlled lower-bracket writer pilot beside Fable's exploratory organism. It may release literal audited values for one manifest and use them heuristically to choose the next sleeper assay; it cannot diagnose a mechanism or establish sufficiency, efficacy, generalization, continual learning, or a paper claim.

nodes.before: v7 simultaneously authorized two no-model sealers and said target access was unauthorized; pre-panel branch-failure scope was implicit.
nodes.after: Exactly two no-model candidate reset/measurement sealers are authorized after architecture ratification; every model target action/result remains forbidden until run ratification; every ordinary pre-panel failure terminates the whole manifest.
nodes.rationale: Makes the finite gate executable without weakening target blindness or creating a branch-dependent salvage result.

nodes.before: v7's registered claim was descriptive but scattered prose used sufficiency and mechanistic diagnosis language.
nodes.after: Release only literal exact-manifest statuses, rational values, signs/equality, and whether any action/score differed; any next-design choice is explicitly heuristic.
nodes.rationale: Prevents four syntactic targets from being promoted into a mechanism or general-effect claim.

nodes.before: v7 could be read as requiring bitwise training replay and did not operationalize independent fixture provenance.
nodes.after: T05 reconstructs discrete sample/update provenance and verifies realized publication/mount hashes without numerical replay; T01/T02 goldens use independent oracles that do not import production helpers.
nodes.rationale: Preserves audit strength without adding a reproducibility study or self-confirming fixtures.

edges.before: The v7 authority wording could block its own environment evidence.
edges.after: Two CPU/no-model sealers may produce only the declared URI/bitcode/reset/I0/IOz eligibility evidence; T04 alone may bind it into a candidate run manifest for human ratification.
edges.rationale: Distinguishes environment sealing from learned target evaluation.

edges.before: T05 update recomputation and downstream interpretation admitted incompatible readings.
edges.after: Immutable telemetry, adapter/mount hashes, packets, cells, and exact rational arithmetic are audited under the frozen semantics; only then can literal results leave quarantine.
edges.rationale: Closes actual-run provenance and claim scope with one release edge.

loops.before: v7 defined the intended common-prefix, forked wake, and two E sleeps, with pre-panel failure scope left partly implicit.
loops.after: Retain v7 exactly; add global manifest termination on the first ordinary pre-panel failure and immediate termination on any integrity failure.
loops.trigger: One frozen common prefix followed by H/E continuation and the two declared E sleep boundaries.
loops.stop_condition: Successful panel entry, RUN_INCOMPLETE for any pre-panel ordinary failure, or INTEGRITY_FAILURE; no unaffected branch continues.
loops.rationale: Ensures the final panel always refers to one complete registered life.

loops.before: v7 froze missing-cell suppression but left update-recompute wording broad.
loops.after: Retain the twelve cold logical cells; after completion or PANEL_INCOMPLETE, reconstruct discrete update provenance and every cell/score from immutable receipts, without floating-point retraining.
loops.trigger: Successful panel entry and then closure of all possible frozen cells.
reads: sealed H/E snapshots and E adapter
loops.stop_condition: Passing V6S8_T05 or INTEGRITY_FAILURE; target-cell ordinary failure alone allows remaining cells and PANEL_INCOMPLETE.
loops.rationale: Makes the final evidence auditable and the allowed conclusion finite.

claims.before: v7 mixed a narrow descriptive registry with prose about sufficiency, poisoning, interference, and no transferable structure.
claims.after: After T05, state only the audited status, raw curves, exact rational F/D values, signs/equality, and whether the one mounted adapter changed actions or registered scores in this manifest; future design choices are heuristic.
claims.evidence_needed: Exact architecture and run ratifications, passing T01--T05, complete finite provenance, and the syntactic-holdout limitation.

claims.before: Any conclusion that direct action cloning is sufficient, harmful as a mechanism, poisoned/interfering, generically ineffective, or evidence of intelligent sleep.
claims.after: Forbidden for this pilot, regardless of value signs.
claims.evidence_needed: A later replicated registered study with appropriate controls, semantic task characterization, thresholds, and inference.

cells.reason: Synthetic packet fixtures and no-model reset state only.
The model receives only the current canonical public packet.
Each call receives condition-local public state; the writer receives exact eligible common/E packets.
Each cell receives one target-local packet from its sealed snapshot.
The reviewer reconstructs all packet/state transitions.
The shared prefix has no condition or adapter object.
Adapter effects are below the prompt; labels/rows/optimizer/telemetry remain offline.
Only assigned weights or NONE affect inference; labels and trainer state remain offline.
T03 observes only no-model candidate reset/baseline measurements, never a target action/result.
No target cell or learned target result exists.
No target result can reach a life, memory, row, or choice.
Cell receipts are offline-only and cannot enter another model call or writer.
The reviewer opens sealed cells only after model execution ends.

acceptance_tests.setup: An independently authored CPU oracle that imports no production serializer/reducer/parser reconstructs canonical packets, every slot transition, memory, exact fork clone, rational scores, and failure status.
acceptance_tests.expected: Production output matches literal frozen fixtures; first post-fork public packets are identical before the E mount; provenance proves oracle separation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Unique execution of the public state/action/fork semantics.

acceptance_tests.setup: An independent CPU fixture path reconstructs eligibility/dedup/order, literal tokenizer arrays and masks, update schedule, q/v inventory, optimizer order on toy tensors, and publication failures without importing production helpers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every row/mask/update/module/failure matches frozen expectations, and fixture provenance proves separation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Unique and support-gated implementation of the minimal writer.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exactly two fresh CPU/no-model invocations enumerate and cold-reset unchanged local CompilerGym candidates using only the frozen sealer algorithm.
acceptance_tests.expected: Byte-identical ordered 8/4 manifests; twelve unique URIs and bitcode hashes; exact repeated Autophase/I0/IOz; no model action, target result, Fable input, tuning, or substitution.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh history-free reviewer and non-overriding advocate inspect exact composite v8 bytes, implementation, T01--T03 evidence/provenance, frozen audit schemas/telemetry, run manifest, commands, finite data paths, and quantitative 7B GH200 budget.
acceptance_tests.expected: Reviewer approves exact constructibility/closure or vetoes; approval only permits presenting that manifest once for human run ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Closure and feasibility of the controlled pilot.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh history-free reviewer reconstructs every actual packet/action/state/memory/row/token/mask/update index/config/publication/mount/cell/rational score/status from immutable evidence, without floating-point retraining.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only a passing audit releases any status/raw cell/value; target feedback or any provenance mismatch becomes INTEGRITY_FAILURE and suppresses all numbers.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Support for any released exact-run description.

human_boundary.decision_question: Do you ratify the exact composite v8 bytes (the bound v7 base plus v8 amendments) as the separate controlled lower-bracket pilot, authorizing isolated implementation, independent CPU fixtures, and exactly two no-model environment sealers? After T01--T04, one exact 7B GH200 manifest will be presented once for the required run ratification.
forbidden_before_approval: Implementation, CPU sealing, model calls, training, target cells, GPU use, or result claims before exact composite architecture ratification
Any model/GPU call before T04 approval and later exact run-manifest ratification
Any model-conditioned selected-target action, target-cell receipt/result opening, target feedback, or training use before the exact run authorization
Any Fable program, prompt, trace, result, adapter, or threshold used to select, tune, train, or score this pilot
Any hidden repair, substitution, retry, resume, added arm, categorical effect interpretation, or broadened claim without a new bound change
